[ASSISTANT_SAID] Funnel cakes are a staple at many amusement parks and can be topped with powdered sugar, strawberries, blueberries, or Nutella.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Corn dogs are a tasty and convenient option at amusement parks, with variations like foot-long corn dogs or ones with unique toppings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Churros are sweet fried dough pastries often drizzled with chocolate or caramel sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Giant turkey legs are iconic at many amusement parks, often slow-roasted and paired with sides like mac 'n cheese or fries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cotton candy is a nostalgic favorite, with unique flavors like blue raspberry or sour apple.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Elephant ears are crispy, sugary treats shaped like an elephant ear, often topped with cinnamon sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fresh lemonade is a refreshing drink option, with flavors like strawberry or raspberry available.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gourmet burgers with unique toppings are offered at many amusement parks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fried Oreos are deep-fried Oreos often drizzled with chocolate or caramel sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specialty drinks like frozen hot chocolate, fruit-flavored sodas, or specialty coffee drinks can be found at amusement parks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should stay hydrated and take breaks throughout the day at the amusement park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Disneyland is a foodie's paradise with many must-try food items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dole Whip is a classic Disneyland treat, a pineapple-flavored soft-serve ice cream.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Disneyland's churros are a staple and can be found at various carts throughout the park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Monte Cristo Sandwich is a Disneyland exclusive found at the Blue Bayou Restaurant or Cafe Orleans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bengal Barbecue offers delicious skewers of meat and famous bacon-wrapped asparagus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ghirardelli Chocolate can be found at the Ghirardelli Soda Fountain and Chocolate Shop, offering a variety of chocolate treats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Carthay Circle Lobster Nachos are a must-try at the Carthay Circle Lounge in Disney California
